original_test_intent: Confirm the exact firmware package's release note is complete, readable and correctly versioned, with technically clear and accurate descriptions of general information, new features, fixed defects and known issues.
original_method: Hash and bind the note to firmware package/build/product scope; render/extract without modification; verify required sections and nonempty fields; compare stated version against signed/approved package metadata rather than filename; run spell/readability checks with page/line references; reconcile feature/fix/known-issue entries with approved source lists; qualified firmware reviewer resolves semantic accuracy and disposition.
manual_activity: Qualified firmware/product reviewer confirms technical completeness/accuracy/clarity; agent may extract, render and produce section/version/spelling findings.
required_inputs: Exact release-note file and firmware package/build hashes
Approved product/platform scope and authoritative firmware version metadata
Required release-note template/sections and source feature/fix/known-issue lists
Qualified review authority and unpublished/security disclosure policy
safety_requirements: Preserve original artifacts and hashes; never silently edit
Distinguish spell/format findings from technical accuracy
Stop acceptance/publication on mismatch, missing section or unresolved ambiguity
agent_execution_scope: Render/extract and check required sections, spelling/readability and exact version
Create page/line-referenced findings and source-list reconciliation
Do not invent wording, decide technical accuracy, overwrite/publish artifacts or set verdict
engineer_actions: Approve package-note pairing, version/source lists and template
Disposition every finding and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No shell command alone can establish semantic clarity, but deterministic document extraction, section/version and spelling checks are appropriate.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use format-appropriate read-only extraction/rendering and a traceable checklist tied to package and note hashes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All four listed content areas and readability/version/clarity criteria remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind immutable artifacts, automate objective checks and route semantic/source reconciliation to an authorized reviewer.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds hashes, package pairing, authoritative sources, finding locations and controlled dispositions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Correct spelling and a matching filename do not prove the note describes the actual build or discloses every approved known issue.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OCR/extraction can miss layout content; human review must use the rendered original and approved change sources.

project_override_considerations: If one release note covers multiple components/builds, require an explicit component-version matrix and product applicability rather than a single global version comparison.
expected_evidence: Release-note and package/build hashes plus product scope
Authoritative version comparison and spelling/readability findings
Feature/fix/known-issue source reconciliation and reviewer dispositions
Approved artifact reference and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently cover release-note structure, readability, version correctness and clarity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The hybrid review is executable when the exact artifacts, source baselines and reviewer are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2277 Wistron-HW-00447-V002: approve exact firmware package/build and release-note file/hash pairing, product/platform scope and authoritative FW version source; required template/sections and approved feature/defect-fix/known-issue source lists; define spelling/readability policy, multi-component version handling, security/unpublished disclosure controls, qualified semantic reviewer and finding disposition/acceptance criteria.

review_improvement: Keeps human technical judgment while making objective document and version traceability reproducible and non-destructive.
independent_technical_reasoning: A release note is part of release configuration control, so correctness depends on an immutable pairing with the actual firmware build and authoritative change/issue sources. Spelling and section presence can be checked mechanically, but 'clear' and technically accurate wording requires product context. Filename-derived versions and OCR-only review are insufficient. Findings must identify exact locations and preserve the original while an authorized reviewer dispositions semantic and disclosure issues.
